agents.result: Current SRS covers strict eight-tool parity, canonical JSON, redaction, and no MCP indexing controls; missing explicit client-profile/model-size conformance.
agents.recommendation: Add CON-MCP-008 as an MCP conformance requirement layered on IR-MCP-018 and CON-MCP-007.

agents.focus: Small-model and frontier-model tool-selection failure modes
agents.result: Small models need compact self-routing descriptions and strict schemas; frontier models need explicit forbidden orchestration boundaries.
agents.recommendation: Use golden intent fixtures and redacted corrective errors; do not add aliases or MCP indexing/import controls.

agents.focus: Tool affordance, result envelope, diagnostics, and portability
agents.result: Exactly eight tools should remain; diagnostics should be exposed through existing save/search envelopes and bounded includeDiagnostics behavior.
agents.recommendation: Keep content[0].text canonical JSON, bounded diagnostics, portable schema subset, and client conformance matrix.

integratedFollowUp.decision: Preserve CON-DOC-006 and DR-DOC-013 as the DOC-owned broken-link lifecycle. MCP conformance must verify non-blocking redacted broken-link diagnostics and must not add import or reconciliation controls.
